$comment: Deploy targets. One entry per destination; `node scripts/deploy.mjs <target>` reads this.
Each target names FOUR things that must agree, because they are the four ways a deploy
can land somewhere you did not mean:
account    the Zoho login the Catalyst CLI must be authenticated as. This is the one
setting that lives OUTSIDE the repo (machine-wide, see the guide §1.5), so
it is the only one a `cd` cannot get right for you. deploy.mjs reads the
CLI's own config and refuses to run when it does not match.
dc         Zoho data centre the account belongs to ('in', 'com', 'eu', ...). The CLI
keeps one login per DC, so the account check is meaningless without it.
catalystrc the .catalystrc payload — which Catalyst project + environment.
envFile    which git-ignored .env file supplies the AppSail env_variables.
Adding a target: add an entry, add its deploy/<name>.catalystrc.json, and create its
env file from backend/.env.production.example. Nothing else needs to change.
